messages.content:
Outcome: Depressive symptoms (lower is better)

## Study A
Found: benefit
Claim: Vitamin D plus probiotic co-supplementation lowered Beck Depression Inventory scores compared with placebo in women with PCOS.
Sentence: "Vitamin D and probiotic co-supplementation, compared with the placebo, significantly improved beck depression inventory [β (difference in the mean of outcomes measures between treatment groups) - 0.58; 95% CI, - 1.15, - 0.02; P = 0.04], general health questionnaire scores (β - 0.93; 95% CI, - 1.78, - 0.08; P = 0.03) and depression, anxiety and stress scale scores (β - 0.90; 95% CI, - 1.67, - 0.13; P = 0.02)."
Measured as: beck depression inventory score
Population: Women with polycystic ovary syndrome aged 18-40 years
Intervention: 50,000 IU vitamin D every 2 weeks plus 8 × 10^9 CFU/day probiotic for 12 weeks
Comparator: Placebo
Design: randomized controlled trial
Sample size: 60
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

## Study B
Found: no effect
Claim: Vitamin D supplementation did not change depressive symptoms (HAMD-17) compared with control in patients with low vitamin D.
Sentence: "The HAMD-17, RSAS, and RPAS scores did not change significantly between VD and control groups from baseline to endpoint (all p > .05)."
Measured as: depressive symptoms (HAMD-17)
Population: Patients with depression and anxiety with low serum 25(OH)D levels
Intervention: Daily vitamin D supplementation for 6 months
Comparator: Control group
Design: randomized controlled trial
Sample size: not reported
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

content.text: {"rationale":"Both bear on vitamin D and depressive symptoms but differ in population (PCOS women vs depressed/anxious patients with low 25(OH)D), intervention (vitamin D plus probiotic vs vitamin D alone) and instrument (self-report BDI vs clinician HAMD-17), so the opposing results are genuine.","verdict":"genuine","reason":"population","also_differs":["intervention","outcome_measure","comparator"],"detail":"PCOS women without clinical depression vs patients with depression and anxiety; vitamin D plus probiotic vs vitamin D alone; BDI vs HAMD-17"}
